_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Rudder Stock Forging History
summary: This forging history provides complete metallurgical data for the rudder stock(s) to assist in structural design and repair during the life of the ship.
description_purpose: This forging history provides complete metallurgical data for the rudder stock(s) to assist in the structural design of rudders and their supports and to facilitate repair of the stock(s) during the life of the ship.
application_interrelationship:
This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
This DID is applicable to all metal alloy rudder stock forgings.
This DID supersedes UDI-E-23105A.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The forging history shall be typewritten or computer printed on 8-1/2" X 11" white paper using contractor format. Any nonstandard abbreviation shall be defined. If necessary, one-way foldouts may be used for oversized descriptive material. All pages and attachments or enclosures shall be securely bound together.

preparation_instructions.title: General.
preparation_instructions.content: The Rudder Stock Forging History shall document in detail the results of chemical and physical testing of the forging(s). The Rudder Stock Forging History introductory information identifying the forging manufacturer, the shipbuilding contractor, the contract number, and the ship to receive the forgings.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The rudder stock forging history shall also include:

children.title: The results of chemical analyses of all forging heats.
The size of the forging(s) at the time of heat treatment.
The heat treatment and tempering temperatures and durations.
The results of mechanical test performed on each forging to show conformance with the applicable material specification.
The forging history shall include any descriptive material, i.e., tables, charts, sketches, drawings, calculations, or photographs necessary to clarify or explain the text.
